title: Distributed In-Memory Cache Inconsistency
ground_truth_flaw: Using @lru_cache in a multi-replica microservice environment causes state drift between nodes.
expected_optimal_solution: Use distributed Redis cache with invalidation pub/sub.

title: The Elegant Distributed Deadlock (Challenging Case)
ground_truth_flaw: Two services acquire locks in reverse order (lock_a then lock_b vs lock_b then lock_a), causing catastrophic distributed deadlocks under concurrent traffic.
expected_optimal_solution: Enforce global lock ordering hierarchy (e.g. always acquire lock_a before lock_b).
